events.title: Tupac Shakur's Passing
events.blurb: On this day in 1996, influential rapper Tupac Shakur was tragically shot in Las Vegas, passing away six days later.

angles.name: Tupac's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering the profound impact of Tupac Shakur, whose music continues to resonate decades on. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Jimi Hendrix's Passing
events.blurb: On this day in 1970, the legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix passed away at the age of 27.

angles.name: Guitar God Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering Jimi Hendrix, a true innovator who redefined what was possible with a guitar. His legacy still electrifies.

events.title: The Beatles Release Abbey Road
events.blurb: The Beatles' iconic 'Abbey Road' album was released on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years since The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. That iconic cover, those timeless tracks... still pure genius.

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Happy 75th Birthday to Chrissie Hynde, the enduring frontwoman of The Pretenders, born on this day in 1951.

angles.name: Chrissie Hynde's 75th
angles.copy: Celebrating Chrissie Hynde turning 75! The Pretenders' legend still rocking as hard as ever. What's your top track from her?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Liam Gallagher, the iconic frontman of Oasis and solo artist, celebrates his 54th birthday today, born in 1972.

angles.name: Liam Gallagher's 54th
angles.copy: Our Kid is 54! Happy Birthday to Liam Gallagher – still one of the most distinctive voices in British music. What's your favourite Oasis or solo anthem?

events.title: John Lennon Releases 'Imagine'
events.blurb: John Lennon's seminal album 'Imagine' was released on this day in 1971.

angles.name: Imagine Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-five years since John Lennon gave us 'Imagine'. An album that still inspires peace and reflection.

events.title: First iPod Released
events.blurb: On this day in 2001, Apple introduced the first-generation iPod, revolutionising how we listen to music.

angles.name: iPod's 25th Anniversary
angles.copy: Remember the click wheel? Twenty-five years ago, the original iPod dropped and changed music forever. How many songs did you cram onto yours?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: Global James Bond Day marks the anniversary of the world premiere of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Favourite Bond Moment
angles.copy: It's James Bond Day! From iconic gadgets to unforgettable theme tunes, what's your ultimate 007 moment?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today, born in 1940.

angles.name: John Lennon Tribute
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we're celebrating the enduring legacy of John Lennon. A true visionary whose music still unites us.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Happy 87th Birthday to the legendary British comedian and actor, John Cleese, born on this day in 1939.

angles.name: John Cleese's 87th
angles.copy: Celebrating the magnificent John Cleese on his 87th birthday! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, a true master of British comedy.

events.title: The Beatles Release 'White Album'
events.blurb: The Beatles' iconic double album, officially titled 'The Beatles' but known as the 'White Album', was released on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: It's 58 years since The Beatles dropped the incredible 'White Album'. So much diverse brilliance on one record. What's your hidden gem from it?

events.title: Freddie Mercury's Passing
events.blurb: On this day in 1991, the iconic Queen frontman Freddie Mercury passed away at the age of 45.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the one and only Freddie Mercury. Thirty-five years since we lost a true showman whose voice still echoes.

events.title: The Beatles Release 'Rubber Soul'
events.blurb: The Beatles' groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' was released on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Anniversary
angles.copy: Sixty-one years since The Beatles delivered 'Rubber Soul'. A landmark album that marked a creative turning point. What's your favourite track?

events.title: John Lennon's Passing
events.blurb: On this day in 1980, the world lost a musical icon with the tragic passing of John Lennon.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: Forty-six years ago today, we lost John Lennon. His music and message of peace continue to inspire generations.
